method: Manual independent CROSS semantic judgment of all 40 frozen expected/criticalExpected conditions against the complete recorded actual history and current generated response. Blind to every other review and historical outputs/metrics; no reserved evaluation or TEST was read. Independence is from the primary AI review, not an independent human panel. Boolean native dimensions are preserved; 0/.5/1 semanticScore is supplementary (all 40 = 0). Critical failures require an intelligible affirmative assertion violating the explicit criticalExpected; omitted answers and uninterpretable fragments are failed without fabricating critical assertions. No model inference, training or software tests. Native assessor executed unchanged through stdlib AST extraction on one allowed CPU.
